description: We are an arts and mental health charity with a 30 year legacy in Lewisham, reframing mental health through creativity and community. We will be opening our studios and community garden in Deptford to the public and be offering a free creative workshop.

events.name: Drop in: Creative Garden Activity
events.notes: Join us for an exciting creative art activity inspired by our lovely community garden! All ages and experiences welcome.

factsheet.heading: Arts Network open house
paragraphs: Arts Network is a member-led charity reframing mental health through creativity and community. Our mission is to use creative engagement to support people with severe and enduring mental health needs, helping individuals feel included, valued, and connected.

Our home in Deptford is our creative heart where we run workshops in all sorts of mediums from sculpture, mosaic to craft and print making and more. For the open house we are opening our doors to the wider public to showcase our vibrant studio and the wonderful artwork of our members.
Alongside our studio we have a peaceful community garden that you can explore and take part in a free creative activity inspired by whats growing.

location.address: Arts Network, Art Hub Studios, Mornington Centre, Stanley St, SE8 4BL
travel_info: Additional travel info: We share our site with Art Hub Studios, please follow the signs to their gallery entrance and you will find signs leading to us.
